Quick Guide: How to Use Tools

• Floating Bubble: Drag it up/down or across; it snaps automatically to screen edges.
• 6 Gestures: Draw a Clockwise/CCW Circle, L-Shape Up/Down, or Upper/Lower Edge Triangle.
• Single Tap (Screenshot): Select any region to save directly to the private clipboard (or Gallery if enabled).
• Double Tap (OCR): Extract & copy text (English offline; Arabic via AI API key in AI Chat).
• Long Press: Opens the tools menu (Pin Image, Clipboard, Google Search, Google Translate, AI Chat).

1. Ethical & Islamic Compliance Condition:
By using MedTech Tools (Every Student's Tool), you pledge and agree NOT to use this application in anything that violates the teachings of Islam, nor in any doubtful or prohibited fields, businesses, or academic specializations.

2. Privacy & Local Storage:
All screenshots and clips are stored privately inside the app's internal memory (hidden from your phone gallery unless you enable saving to Gallery) and are never uploaded anywhere unless you explicitly share them to Google Search or your own configured AI API.
